text:
Maya P: Quick Q for folks: several APAC reviewers asked for a staggered deadline because their managers are in different timezones and some teams run final calibration on 24th UTC. Can we offer a formal exception window?

Amanda R: What's the ask? extra 48h for APAC reviewers? We need to be careful about calibration fairness.

Maya P: Managers requested a 36h soft extension for reviewers in +8 to +12 timezones so they can finish after their local workday. A few teams also have contributors on leave.

People Ops Bot: Note: Policy "review-deadline-exception" requires manager approval and an exception record in the reviews DB.

Santiago V: From an ops perspective we can support a targeted exception list. Two constraints: 1) exports for calibration must be locked at the new cutoff, 2) handback automation needs the exception flag.

Jess M: Practically, we should: 1) collect affected reviewer emails, 2) require manager signoff (simple thumbs-up in reply), 3) call a one-off job to set exception_flag=true for those reviewer rows. I can draft the manager signoff template.

Amanda R: I like that. Also note: we should avoid cloning forms; better to keep single source of truth and flip flags. QA: will exceptions be visible in calibration CSV? Santiago?

Santiago V: yes, we'll add a column exception_window and new_cutoff_iso to the calibration export. I'll coordinate with eng to add a filter so evaluators see which reviews are late-exempt. ETA 2h.

Maya P: I'll collect emails now. Sending a DM to leads asking for manager approval in-thread.

Amanda R: Heads-up: we should limit exceptions to reviewers (not reviewees) and cap to folks with timezone or documented leave to avoid gaming. Add a reason field when we record the exception.

Jess M: Draft manager approval message: 

"Hi <manager>, we propose a 36-hour reviewer deadline exception for these team members due to timezone constraints or approved leave. Reply with 'approve' to confirm. We'll log it in the review system and update calibration exports."

Maya P: Sending now. 7 approvals already. Adding emails to a CSV.

People Ops Bot: Exception request created: EXC-3987. Pending approvals: 3.

Santiago V: Once approvals reach 0 I'll run the exception job. FYI the job will tag rows with: exception=EXC-3987, exempt_until=2026-02-28T23:59:59Z. Please confirm the exact ISO you'd like.

Amanda R: Use 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z — that covers the 36h extension for the affected set and keeps calibration on March 2nd UTC.

Jess M: I'll include instructions for reviewers: "If you see the form unlocked after your original deadline, that means you were granted an exception. Please submit as soon as possible — we still expect managers to complete reviews within the exception window."

Maya P: All approvals are in. CSV uploaded to /internal/people-ops/exceptions/EXC-3987/list.csv

People Ops Bot: EXC-3987 approvals: 0. Ready to execute exception job.

Santiago V: Exception job completed at 1811123625. Calibration export schema updated. Spot-check: 5 sample reviewers show exception_window=36h and exempt_until=2026-02-28T23:59:59Z.

Amanda R: Thanks. Jess, please send the manager + reviewer communication and flag to calibration team. I'll record a post-action note.

Jess M: Sent comms to managers + reviewers. Notifying calibration lead. I'll follow-up if any stray late submissions appear.

People Ops Bot: EXC-3987 resolved and logged in audit at 1811123720.
